title: WebGPU present path: frame times and tier fidelity on one device
description: Browser runner (/gpu/bench.html) renders the three G4 seeds at every quality tier for a fixed frame count after a warm-up of at least 120 frames and 5 s (each stage remounts the renderer; late pipeline compilation is reported as stutter), then one sustained Ultra stage. Snapshots include the bounded simulation (magnitude plane), as the GPU lab publishes them. The capture carries per-frame wall times, GPU timestamps where exposed, adapter info and 128 px thumbnails. Python scores p50/p95/p99, 1% low, pacing, drift, budget checks and same-device fidelity against Ultra. Measured only: a capture from this runner is hardware evidence for the device it names and nothing else.
